title: A cap for my mug
description: Four views of a mug with its lid missing. Start with the fit and the measurements.
prompt: I lost the lid for this mug and want to make a replacement cap. Here are four photos of the mug, rim, and inner grooves. I have a caliper with me and have not supplied any dimensions. Inspect the photos, then generate one clear instructional sketch sheet (up to three sketches/views) showing exactly where to place the caliper to measure the opening, lip and seating depth. Mark the measurements A, B, C, etc.; do not invent numbers or scale. Publish it with crafty_forms.publish_measurement_guide and give me a short request_dimensions form with guides mapping the sketch to its fields, matching letter labels and caliper hints, plus fit/use questions. Keep the original photos only as source references, without repeating them in the measurement request. Leave all measurements blank for me.
